items.title: The Burgundy Wedding
items.summary: A romantic celebration in burgundy, ivory and gold.
items.vision: A romantic and elegant celebration inspired by rich burgundy tones, natural textures and timeless details. The goal was an intimate atmosphere that felt both modern and classic.
elements: Classic colour palette: burgundy, ivory and gold
items.coordination: We managed the florist, rentals, caterer and photographer on one shared timeline, with a full walkthrough the day before.
items.quote: This project was a chance to bring creativity, planning and coordination together, and to show how the right details can turn a space into a meaningful celebration.
